Best icon

Icon B · Looking Up

Each column has its own Light/Dark switch for the live mock and the city strip. The palette swatches always show both modes. Contrast ratios are computed from the hex values (WCAG 2.x): text pairs need 4.5:1, the focus ring and XP bar need 3:1. The mock chips are 30px tall to fit the board; in the app they stay 44px.

App icon

Four icons, one dog

Each is flat, geometric, full-bleed (so it works as an Android maskable icon), and uses at most one letter or none. The 16px version is a favicon cut with the fine details dropped. Shown on a light and a dark surface at 180, 64, 32 and 16 px.

My recommendation

Night Shift with the Bullet Pup

Go with Night Shift. Your 3D city is already a dusk-and-lit-windows scene, and swapping the purple haze for asphalt navy and sodium orange makes every window glow harder, which suits studying at night and sidesteps the purple-gradient look. Pair it with icon A, the Bullet Pup: a scrappy dog in a subway bullet is the clearest underdog and the clearest New York in one shape, and it is still readable at 16px. Keep Fredoka and Nunito so the 80% you love stays put.

Themes can be mixed

The tokens are independent, so you can combine them. The strongest mix is Night Shift surfaces with Subway category colours: Python, Math, ML/DL, Papers and Writing/X become real line bullets, and the orange button stays. Brownstone's light mode also pairs well with Subway's bullets if you want a daytime theme. Say which parts you want and I will wire it into the stylesheet.
